spans.s: Ā. (द्रियते, दृत; desid. दिदरिषते) (rarely used by itself, usually found in combination with आ)
To respect, honour, worship, reverence; द्वितीयाद्रियते सदा H.
To care for, mind; usually with न.
To apply or devote oneself closely to, have regard for; भूरि श्रुतं शाश्वतमाद्रियन्ते
P. (दारयति, दरयति) to fear; L. D. B.
To burst or break asunder, split open.
To cause to burst, tear, divide, rend, sunder, pull to pieces. -Pass. (दीर्यते)
To burst, break open, be sundered; कथमेवं प्रलपतां वः सहस्रधा न दीर्ण- मनया जिह्वया
To split, tear asunder, divide by digging.
P. (दरति) To fear, be afraid of. (With prepositions like अव, आ, प्र, &c. the root does not change its meaning.)
